description: Claims for the design-vs-code consistency check. The corpus is eval/corpus with the files in eval/seeded_patches overlaid: six deliberate mismatches were introduced into the CODE/CONFIG while the design documents were left untouched. `seeded` claims state the design and should be flagged potential_discrepancy; `consistent` claims are true of both design and code; `unsupported` claims are about things neither design nor code addresses. Authored by hand before any run.

seeded_changes.change: apply_poison replaces the stack count (poison_stacks = 1) instead of stacking up to POISON_MAX_STACKS; the design says it stacks up to 3. The config still says poison_max_stacks: 3.
boss enrage multiplies speed by 1.25; the design says +50 percent.
SELL_REFUND_RATIO is 0.5; the design says 60 percent (config still says 0.6).
upgrade cost uses 0.5 * base_cost * (level + 1); the design says 0.75.
damage per upgrade level adds 20 percent; the design says 25 percent.

claims.claim: Selling a tower refunds 60 percent of the gold invested in it.
When a boss enrages it gains 50 percent more movement speed.
Upgrading a tower to level N costs 0.75 times its base cost times N.
Interest on unspent gold is capped at 50 gold per wave.
Each upgrade level adds 25 percent to a tower's base damage.
Armor is subtracted from every hit, but no hit ever deals less than 1 damage.
The player may have at most 12 towers at once.
A tower can be upgraded to level 3 at most.
The player starts each run with 200 gold.
Save files are encrypted with AES-256.
The Venom Tower fires two shots per second.
Defeated enemies drop random loot items.
